records.title: Enquiry whether an MMD command or representative is present
records.header_literal: C) --- v --- (06.05 p.m., November 14th); FUER ASO RAT 13.41; RICHI-126
records.readable_german: Befindet sich dort Kommando MMD oder Vertreter. Admiralstab 15?6?D?.
records.meaning: The message asks whether the command labeled MMD, or a representative, is present at the destination. It closes with Admiralstab and the unresolved reference 15?6?D?. The source does not expand MMD or identify the destination.
notes: The native source contains126 slots, including the final AAGFF G. The first-row fifth group has a Y-like or Y/V-uncertain third glyph, conservatively retained as FVYAG and masked at source 22.

The raw KOMM?NDO unknown comes from the fully observed VG square cell, not from the Y-like source glyph. Its domain is {2,3,4,7,8,9,Q,Y}; proposing A therefore costs an observed G→V substitution at source 112. No unknown key cell is silently assigned A.
The final reference has two fully observed unknown square cells GD and AD, and a final source-mask pair ?G. Their domains remain explicit; they are not forced into a numerical date or serial number.
The single source mask remains unresolved. The final character domain is {2,3,4,6,7,8,9,B,G,P,Q,R,Y}, while the earlier two unknown cells range over {2,3,4,7,8,9,Q,Y}.
The question is punctuated with a period in the exact reading so that ? continues to denote an unresolved plaintext position.

The three final unknown labels must be distinct globally: GD and AD are different square cells, and the masked pair ?G cannot become either. Its known-cell alternatives are B, P, R, 6 and G; an unused label can arise only through the separate VG cell. The listed marginal domains are not independent choices.
